_comment: Pre-declared before running: an independent repeat of the five V sets in float32 (BDNMC_JAX_PRECISION=float32), after the first float32 run missed two single statistics against stock. Committed before the jobs start; the result is judged only by the rule below.

previous_result.against_stock: pi0 V1 fail (one pull 3.13, he_pi0_cuboid_m020; limit 3); brem V2 fail (one tail pull 3.15; limit 3); eta and off-shell pass; particle_list V1 pass, V2 fails on the parent histograms only, as in float64
previous_result.against_float64: V1 and V2 pass on all five sets

rerun.reference: the same stock reference sets as every earlier run

control.role: the same repeat in float64, reported alongside and used for compare_precision.py; a failure here would point at the criteria or the reference, not at float32, and is reported as such

float32_validated_if_all: pi0, brem, eta and off-shell: the float32 rerun passes every V1 and V2 criterion of its config against stock
particle_list: V1 passes, and every V2 failure is a parent histogram (parent_p, parent_theta), as for float64
float32 against the float64 control (compare_precision.py): V1 and V2 pass on all five sets
no failed shard in any float32 set
decision_rule.otherwise: not validated; the failing statistics are looked at against the float64 control before anything else
decision_rule.no_further_reruns: a third run to obtain a pass is not allowed under this rule; it would need a new declaration with reasons
decision_rule.reporting: both float32 runs and the float64 control are reported in docs/gpu-validation.md whatever the outcome
